Stylish 1-Bedroom Apartment in Al Manara Tower, Jumeirah Village Triangle

Welcome to your new home in Al Manara Tower. Located in the sought-after community of Jumeirah Village Triangle. This modern 1-bedroom apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and elevated living—set high above the city with breathtaking views of Dubai’s skyline.

Thoughtfully designed, the apartment features a spacious layout with large windows that flood the interior with natural light. The tower itself is complemented by leisure-focused amenities including a swimming pool, fitness center, children’s play areas, and retail spaces.

Set in a vibrant yet peaceful neighborhood, Al Manara Tower offers residents a well-connected lifestyle with easy access to major highways, business districts, and entertainment hubs. Whether you’re looking for a stylish new home or a smart investment, this property delivers on all fronts.
